endpoint_scope.clinical_complete: root overrides on 39 critical/failure cases plus heterogeneous proxy elsewhere
endpoint_scope.complete_or_partial: sensitivity endpoint that also accepts broader/underspecified disease-family labels

external_llm_role: queue-expansion subcontractor only; root owns listed judgments and final interpretation
interpretation_boundary: Only the listed critical and screen-failure cases were root-adjudicated candidate by candidate. Remaining cases retain the heterogeneous screen as a queue-expansion proxy, not as an external-LLM final verdict.

retrieval_screen_analysis.post_treatment_warning: The screen sees generated Top-1 and is a descriptive manipulation audit. Do not treat strata as randomized moderators or replace the ITA factorial.
